title: Ways to make the pagers applets take less space
line: The Pager can now show just the current desktop as a small button that opens a menu to switch desktops.
explanation: The Pager (and Activity Pager) always draws one preview per desktop, so with many desktops it takes a big chunk of the panel and there is no way to shrink it while keeping mouse switching. The change adds a "Display" option to its settings: "All virtual desktops" (unchanged default) or "Current virtual desktop, with a menu to switch". In the compact mode the widget is a single pager-styled button showing the current desktop's number, name or an icon (following the existing Text display option); clicking it opens a menu listing every desktop with the current one checked, and scrolling over it still switches desktops.

commits.message:
applets/pager: add a compact mode with a menu to switch desktops

The pager always draws a preview of every desktop, which takes a lot of
panel space with many desktops. Add a display option that shows only the
current desktop as a button, opening a menu with all of them on click.

BUG: 489371

patches.diff:
From c146b838125fa6fa909ad94370d1687056fab7ed Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:08:33 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/pager: add a compact mode with a menu to switch
 desktops

The pager always draws a preview of every desktop, which takes a lot of
panel space with many desktops. Add a display option that shows only the
current desktop as a button, opening a menu with all of them on click.

BUG: 489371
---
 applets/pager/main.xml              |   4 +
 applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml |  34 ++++++-
 applets/pager/qml/main.qml          | 142 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++-
 3 files changed, 175 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/pager/main.xml b/applets/pager/main.xml
index d47b935b1e..19c1dd7e62 100644
--- a/applets/pager/main.xml
+++ b/applets/pager/main.xml
@@ -6,6 +6,10 @@
   <kcfgfile name=""/>
 
   <group name="General">
+    <entry name="compact" type="Bool">
+      <label>Whether to show only the current desktop, with a menu to switch to the others.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="displayedText" type="Enum">
         <label>The text to show inside the desktop rectangles.</label>
         <choices>
diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml b/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml
index 23074d9ab6..d3ce94e753 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/configGeneral.qml
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     id: root
     readonly property bool isActivityPager: Plasmoid.pluginName === "org.kde.plasma.activitypager"
 
+    property bool cfg_compact
     property int cfg_displayedText
     property alias cfg_showWindowOutlines: showWindowOutlines.checked
     property alias cfg_showWindowIcons: showWindowIcons.checked
@@ -25,6 +26,10 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_wrapPage: wrapPage.checked
 
     Kirigami.FormLayout {
+        QQC2.ButtonGroup {
+            id: compactGroup
+        }
+
         QQC2.ButtonGroup {
             id: displayedTextGroup
         }
@@ -33,23 +38,49 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             id: currentDesktopSelectedGroup
         }
 
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@title:group prefix for radiobutton group", "Display:")
+
+            QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: compactGroup
+            text: root.isActivityPager ? i18nc("@option:radio", "All activities") : i18nc("@option:radio", "All virtual desktops")
+            checked: !root.cfg_compact
+            onToggled: if (checked) root.cfg_compact = false;
+        }
+
+        QQC2.RadioButton {
+            QQC2.ButtonGroup.group: compactGroup
+            text: root.isActivityPager
+                ? i18nc("@option:radio", "Current activity, with a menu to switch")
+                : i18nc("@option:radio", "Current virtual desktop, with a menu to switch")
+            checked: root.cfg_compact
+            onToggled: if (checked) root.cfg_compact = true;
+        }
+
+
+        Item {
+            Kirigami.FormData.isSection: true
+        }
+
+
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: showWindowOutlines
 
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@title:group prefix for checkbox group", "General:")
 
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show window outlines")
+            enabled: !root.cfg_compact
         }
 
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: showWindowIcons
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show application icons on window outlines")
-            enabled: showWindowOutlines.checked
+            enabled: showWindowOutlines.checked && !root.cfg_compact
         }
 
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: showOnlyCurrentScreen
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show only current screen")
+            enabled: !root.cfg_compact
         }
 
         QQC2.CheckBox {
@@ -70,6 +101,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
 
             model: [i18nc("@item:inlistbox The pager layout", "Default"), i18nc("@item:inlistbox The pager layout", "Horizontal"), i18nc("@item:inlistbox The pager layout", "Vertical")]
             visible: root.isActivityPager
+            enabled: !root.cfg_compact
         }
 
 
diff --git a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
index b4211ddbbd..cd2e81c83f 100644
--- a/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/pager/qml/main.qml
@@ -13,6 +13,7 @@ import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.plasma.core as PlasmaCore
 import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
+import org.kde.plasma.extras as PlasmaExtras
 import org.kde.draganddrop as DnD
 import plasma.applet.org.kde.plasma.pager
 import org.kde.plasma.activityswitcher as ActivitySwitcher
@@ -26,17 +27,22 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     readonly property bool isActivityPager: Plasmoid.pluginName === "org.kde.plasma.activitypager"
     readonly property bool vertical: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
+    readonly property bool compact: Plasmoid.configuration.compact
 
     readonly property real aspectRatio: (((pagerModel.pagerItemSize.width * pagerItemGrid.effectiveColumns)
         + ((pagerItemGrid.effectiveColumns * pagerItemGrid.spacing) - pagerItemGrid.spacing))
         / ((pagerModel.pagerItemSize.height * pagerItemGrid.effectiveRows)
         + ((pagerItemGrid.effectiveRows * pagerItemGrid.spacing) - pagerItemGrid.spacing)))
 
-    Layout.minimumWidth: !root.vertical ? Math.floor(height * aspectRatio) : 1
-    Layout.minimumHeight: root.vertical ? Math.floor(width / aspectRatio) : 1
+    readonly property real compactLength: !root.vertical && Plasmoid.configuration.displayedText === 1
+        ? Math.max(height, compactLabel.implicitWidth + compactFrame.margins.horizontal)
+        : (root.vertical ? width : height)
 
-    Layout.maximumWidth: !root.vertical ? Math.floor(height * aspectRatio) : Infinity
-    Layout.maximumHeight: root.vertical ? Math.floor(width / aspectRatio) : Infinity
+    Layout.minimumWidth: !root.vertical ? (root.compact ? compactLength : Math.floor(height * aspectRatio)) : 1
+    Layout.minimumHeight: root.vertical ? (root.compact ? compactLength : Math.floor(width / aspectRatio)) : 1
+
+    Layout.maximumWidth: !root.vertical ? (root.compact ? compactLength : Math.floor(height * aspectRatio)) : Infinity
+    Layout.maximumHeight: root.vertical ? (root.compact ? compactLength : Math.floor(width / aspectRatio)) : Infinity
 
     Plasmoid.status: pagerModel.shouldShowPager ? PlasmaCore.Types.ActiveStatus : PlasmaCore.Types.HiddenStatus
 
@@ -238,10 +244,130 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         dragTimer.restart();
     }
 
+    PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
+        id: compactButton
+
+        anchors.fill: parent
+        visible: root.compact
+        activeFocusOnTab: root.compact
+
+        // Set by the current desktop's delegate
+        property string currentName
+
+        mainText: currentName
+
+        Accessible.name: currentName
+        Accessible.description: root.isActivityPager
+            ? i18nc("@info:whatsthis", "Show a menu to switch activities")
+            : i18nc("@info:whatsthis", "Show a menu to switch virtual desktops")
+        Accessible.role: Accessible.ButtonMenu
+
+        Keys.onPressed: event => {
+            switch (event.key) {
+            case Qt.Key_Space:
+            case Qt.Key_Enter:
+            case Qt.Key_Return:
+            case Qt.Key_Select:
+                desktopMenu.openRelative();
+                break;
+            }
+        }
+
+        TapHandler {
+            onTapped: desktopMenu.openRelative()
+        }
+
+        KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+            id: compactFrame
+            anchors.fill: parent
+            imagePath: "widgets/pager"
+            prefix: compactButton.containsMouse || compactButton.activeFocus || desktopMenu.status === PlasmaExtras.Menu.Open ? "hover" : "active"
+        }
+
+        PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+            id: compactLabel
+
+            anchors {
+                fill: parent
+                topMargin: compactFrame.margins.top
+                leftMargin: compactFrame.margins.left
+                rightMargin: compactFrame.margins.right
+                bottomMargin: compactFrame.margins.bottom
+            }
+
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.displayedText < 2
+            text: Plasmoid.configuration.displayedText ? compactButton.currentName : pagerModel.currentPage + 1
+            textFormat: Text.PlainText
+
+            wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
+            elide: Text.ElideRight
+
+            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
+            verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
+
+            font.pixelSize: Math.min(height, Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize)
+        }
+
+        Kirigami.Icon {
+            anchors.centerIn: parent
+            width: Math.min(parent.width, parent.height) - compactFrame.margins.horizontal
+            height: width
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.displayedText === 2
+            source: root.isActivityPager ? "activities" : "virtual-desktops"
+            active: compactButton.containsMouse
+        }
+    }
+
+    PlasmaExtras.Menu {
+        id: desktopMenu
+
+        visualParent: compactButton
+        placement: {
+            if (Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.LeftEdge) {
+                return PlasmaExtras.Menu.RightPosedTopAlignedPopup;
+            } else if (Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge) {
+                return PlasmaExtras.Menu.BottomPosedLeftAlignedPopup;
+            } else if (Plasmoid.location === PlasmaCore.Types.RightEdge) {
+                return PlasmaExtras.Menu.LeftPosedTopAlignedPopup;
+            } else {
+                return PlasmaExtras.Menu.TopPosedLeftAlignedPopup;
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    PlasmaCore.ActionGroup {
+        id: desktopMenuGroup
+    }
+
+    Instantiator {
+        id: desktopMenuItems
+
+        model: root.compact ? pagerModel : null
+
+        delegate: PlasmaExtras.MenuItem {
+            id: desktopMenuItem
+
+            required property int index
+            required property string display
+
+            action: PlasmaCore.Action {
+                text: desktopMenuItem.display
+                checkable: true
+                checked: desktopMenuItem.index === pagerModel.currentPage
+                actionGroup: desktopMenuGroup
+                onTriggered: pagerModel.changePage(desktopMenuItem.index)
+            }
+        }
+
+        onObjectAdded: (index, object) => desktopMenu.addMenuItem(object, desktopMenuItems.objectAt(index + 1))
+        onObjectRemoved: (index, object) => desktopMenu.removeMenuItem(object)
+    }
+
     Grid {
         id: pagerItemGrid
 
         anchors.centerIn: parent
+        visible: !root.compact
         spacing: 1
         rows: effectiveRows * effectiveColumns >= pagerModel.count ? effectiveRows : pagerModel.count
         columns: effectiveRows * effectiveColumns >= pagerModel.count ? effectiveColumns : pagerModel.count
@@ -592,6 +718,14 @@ PlasmoidItem {
                 }
 
                 onContainsMouseChanged: updateSubTextIfNeeded()
+
+                Binding {
+                    target: compactButton
+                    property: "currentName"
+                    value: desktop.display
+                    when: desktop.isCurrent
+                    restoreMode: Binding.RestoreNone
+                }
             }
         }
     }
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Six desktops: the pager takes about 350 px of the panel.
Compact mode: one button showing the current desktop's name.
Pager settings on master: no way to make it smaller.
New Display option; preview-only options are disabled in compact mode.
Clicking the button opens a menu of desktops; picking one switches to it and the button updates.
